description: Renovate runs as the x-renovate CI job on the SCHEDULE_KIND=deep-check pipeline schedule only, so no schedule window here, and no hourly PR limit. Why: design/agent-workflow.md.

packageRules.description: Group CI image bumps into a single weekly MR. This is the whole job for an R package: there is no CRAN manager, and DESCRIPTION declares version floors resolved against current CRAN at install time, so nothing else here is pinned. The R images come from the fleet-ci template, pinned by SHA; what is left are the images of the x-* jobs in .gitlab-ci.yml.

Never bump the fleet-ci include: its ref must equal .fleet-ci/VERSION, so a bump re-runs fleet-ci's bin/vendor at the same SHA in the same merge request (.gitlab-ci.yml's header), which Renovate cannot do.
